scope: Actual issued action clock tags in the existing native draw consumer, immutable known-uniform retargeting, direct proof admission, relative duration bounds and submitted pick ages. No ordinary action resources or clip/actor projection enabled.
knownFailures: the intent bridge projects a scaled gate using the physical wall frame
loading during a committed strike applies its damage frame exactly once
event-fed native intent bridge replays live state and only changes on explicit deltas
late crate admission is rejected after drop and retries a later pickup
confirmed harvest installs its sampled GPU horizon and cancels on changed target
functionalEvidence: Eleven new receiver cases use actual Game arrival and explicit trusted native action ABI, native control publication and a simulated GPU device. Exact/retained start, simultaneous B route, duration cap/cancel, bad references/capability and terminal end rounding. A real later native world mutation supplies the coordinator cookie; this is not ordinary action admission. Three more cases exercise physical uniform registration/retagging and submitted age precision.

terminalPrecisionFix.after: At the native end both execution reader and submitted age saturate to declared duration (GPU uses floorFloat32).

trustBoundary: Only an already issued action with direct baseline facts can be admitted. Pending action templates are rejected; retained preparation/release/coordinator still pending. Raw native ABI is a trusted owner entry, not a GPU receipt verifier.

build.native: No native changes; standalone/pthread binaries frozen unchanged

gpu.source: Existing first-task scenario, SpatialGameSession in page plus actual prep/draw workers; not new action GPU execution

research.decision: Separate resident animation data from playback parameters. Reuse our native causal clock and finite identity, no dependency/global Babylon clock.
